カードの各能力は、対戦に勝つことでの能力値の増加、攻撃タイプの変化などの特典によ: A card&squo;s abilities grow through the bonuses won by taking matches -- its ability values rise and its attack type can change. The ability values of a card just after you obtain it lie somewhere between half of that card&squo;s maximum and the maximum itself. Very few cards start with their ability values already at maximum. Those values can be raised, up to the maximum, by growing the card through matches. Winning a battle during a match also carries a fixed chance of changing the card to a stronger attack type.

カードを集めるには、対戦で勝って相手のカードを奪うほかに、カードショップでの購入: As well as winning matches and taking your opponent&squo;s cards, you can collect cards by buying them at the card shop, by trading with players connected through PlayOnline, and at auction. The card shop and the auction use Tetra Master&squo;s in-game currency, Tetra (T).
カードゲームの真価は、やり込むことではじめて得られるものです。テトラマスターでは: The true worth of a card game only comes out when you play it to the hilt. In Tetra Master every player is given a "title" that grades how far they have come, according to their play. Holding a high title carries no particular bonus, but it means a great deal as a player&squo;s standing. The prize money ranking, like the title, is a measure of a player&squo;s ability. Those at the top of it are the true "veterans" who know Tetra Master inside out. Think about how efficiently you earn prize money, and aim for the top yourself.
カードショップでのカード購入は、最も簡単にカードが入手できる方法です。そのため、: Buying cards at the card shop is the easiest way to obtain them, so you are likely to use the shop often. The card shop is not merely a place to buy and sell cards; it is also a place that tells you unexpected things. Here we explain buying and selling at the card shop and the messages it displays.
カードショップには、常時さまざまなカードパックが販売されています。カードパックの: The card shop always has a variety of card packs on sale. The price of a card pack and the number of cards it holds vary by type. The more expensive the card pack, the higher the chance of rare and powerful cards.
カードレベルには、各カードの強さを表した&#34;所持カード個別のカードレベル&: There are two kinds of card level: the "card level of each card you hold", which expresses how strong that card is, and the "card level of all the cards you hold", which expresses how rich your collection is. The card level tied to titles and to the conditions for COM characters appearing is the card level of all the cards you hold.
カード上の3つの数字は、カードの能力値表示です。能力値はカードの種類によって異な:
The three numbers on a card are its displayed ability values. The values differ by card type, but the maximum is 110 (displayed as a star).&br;
Each of a card&squo;s three abilities also has its own separate maximum, so they are not necessarily the same number.
ゲームプレイやコンテンツ&br;ID、違反行為などお困りごとに対する回答をまとめ: Proceeds to the top page of&br;&style=Bo15;Need Help?&style;, which collects answers to problems with gameplay, Content IDs, violations and more.

チャンスブロックは、特殊効果の1つである&#34;ガーネット&#34;の効果が強: Because "Garnet", one of the special effects, is so powerful, the main use of a chance block is to destroy it in the hope of drawing that effect. The special effect is chosen at random, though, so Aero or Death may come up instead, and once victory is certain it is better to leave them alone. As with normal blocks, the maximum number of chance blocks is 5 in a two-player match and 8 in a three-player match. The chance of each of the four special effects occurring has nothing to do with the number of players; it is decided when the chance block is destroyed.

テトラマスターにはファイナルファンタジーIXに登場したプレイヤーキャラクターをは: Tetra Master features many characters brimming with personality, starting with the player characters who appeared in FINAL FANTASY IX.&br;There are also COM characters intended for beginners, so if you are playing Tetra Master for the first time, it is a good idea to practice in matches against COM characters first.

テトラマスターのカードには、対戦を行うためのいくつかの数値と矢印、そして攻撃タイ: Tetra Master cards show several values, a set of arrows and an attack type, all used in matches.&br;Knowing your cards&squo; abilities well will raise your win rate. Winning a match has the added bonus of making your cards grow.
テトラマスターのゲームタイトル画面では、右に並んでいるアイコンを使用すると、各項: On the Tetra Master game title screen, using the icons lined up on the right carries out each of the items.
テトラマスターの画面下に表示される6つのアイコンは、プレイオンラインでつながった: The six icons shown at the bottom of the Tetra Master screen are provided as convenient features to help you communicate with fellow members connected through PlayOnline and with other players in Tetra Master.
テトラマスターの遊び方や、プレイ時のルールを詳しく説明した&style=Bo15: Proceeds to the &style=Bo15;Game Manual&style;, which explains how to play Tetra Master and the rules of play in detail.
テトラマスターの醍醐味(だいごみ)は、なんといってもプレイヤー同士の対戦で行われ: The real thrill of Tetra Master is, above all, the strategic give-and-take of matches between players. New strategies, and the decks built around them, are born every day. The "deck building", "strategy" and "combos" explained in this section are the three great elements of Tetra Master strategy. Learn the basic strategy and the theory of deck building, add your own originality, and you should be able to produce an entirely new strategy and deck that are yours alone.
テトラマスターは、2～3人のプレイヤーが&#34;フィールド&#34;と呼ばれる: Tetra Master is a game in which two or three players take turns placing cards one at a time on a battlefield called the "field", starting battles to take their opponents&squo; cards for themselves.&br;As well as matches against COM characters, you can enjoy matches against other players connected through PlayOnline.
テトラマスターは、5枚のカードを使用して対戦するカードゲームです。\r\n\t\:
Tetra Master is a card game played with five cards.
				The hand you use in a match can be chosen freely from your own card collection.
				A set of five such cards is called a "deck".
テトラマスターは、COMキャラクターやプレイオンラインでつながった他のプレイヤー: In Tetra Master you can enjoy a match at any time, against COM characters or against other players connected through PlayOnline. COM characters make good opponents when you have only just started playing, or when you want to try out a newly edited deck. Matches against other players, meanwhile, offer tenser and more heated play.
テトラマスターは、ファイナルファンタジーにちなんださまざまなイラストが描かれたカ:
Tetra Master is a game played with cards bearing all kinds of illustrations drawn from FINAL FANTASY, in which you take your opponent&squo;s cards much as in a territory game.&br; &br;
As well as matches, you can trade cards with other players connected through PlayOnline, and take part in auctions.&br;&br;There are rankings too, so you can see where your own match level stands among the many players out there.
テトラマスターは、他のテーブルゲームやカードゲームのように、先手(1番手)と後手: Like other table games and card games, Tetra Master is played in turn by the first player and by those who follow. Playing first and playing later call for different actions and different thinking. The task for the player going first is to take plenty of cards in the early and middle game and then evade the later players&squo; pursuit at the end; the task for those going later is to break down the strengthened cards of the player who went first.
テトラマスターは、簡単な流れを覚えるだけで対戦が楽しめます。 &br;ここでは: Tetra Master can be enjoyed once you learn a simple sequence.  &br;This section explains the knowledge a match calls for, following the actual flow of play.

				in advance under "Deck Edit" saves you the trouble of picking cards each match.
トレードでは対戦やチャットで知りあった他のプレイヤーと、自由にカードの交換ができ: In a trade you can freely exchange cards with other players you have got to know through matches or chat.&br;To trade, pick the player you want to approach from the member list, then choose Trade from the member menu.
トレードを行った際に表示されるカード取得メッセージには、そのトレードによって自分: The card acquisition message shown when you make a trade carries an appraisal comment telling you whether you came out ahead or behind on that trade. The comment is based on card sale prices: it is decided by how many times greater the sale price of the card you received is than that of the card you handed over. When several cards change hands in a single trade, the total sale price of all of them is what is judged.
バトルが発生すると、カードの中央に数値が表示されます。\r\n\t\t\t\tバ:
When a battle occurs, a number appears in the center of the card.
				The attacking card shows its attack power, and the card being attacked shows
				either its physical defense or its magic defense.
バトルで裏返したカードに、バトルで使用した方向以外の矢印がある場合、その矢印の先: If a card you flipped in a battle has arrows in directions other than the one used in that battle, the adjacent opposing cards those arrows point to become yours as well. This is called a "Combo". When a combo is made, the combo count appears on screen.
バトルに負けたカードは裏返り、カードの色が勝ったプレイヤーの色に変化します。: The card that loses a battle flips over, and its color changes to that of the winning player.
フィールドには、いろいろな効果を持つブロックやタイルが配置されている場合がありま: The field may have blocks and tiles with various effects placed on it. Using these well will let you turn a match to your advantage.

The field may have special "Block" and

フィールドには、特殊な効果を備えたブロックやタイルが設置されていることがあり、そ: The field may have blocks and tiles with special effects placed on it, and making good use of them lets you play a match from a position of advantage. Here we introduce how to put those special blocks and tiles to work, and explain the settings behind block placement and the details of the special effects, which are hard to make out on screen.
プレイを始めたばかりのときは、何をしたら良いのか分からないものです。まずは &#: When you have only just started playing, it is hard to know what to do. Begin by practicing matches in "Playing Against COM". "Netarsha the Flower Girl" is the ideal opponent. As you play, not only will your card collection and your funds grow, but the cards you use will grow too -- and above all, you will get the hang of matches.
プレイヤーと対戦を始めるには、&br;&quot;EMPTY&quot;テーブル: To start a match against other players,&br;reserve a place at an "EMPTY" table&br;and wait for others to join, or reserve&br;a place at a "Recruiting" table that&br;is looking for opponents. Check the&br;table&squo;s status, then act from the&br;table menu. The player who reserves&br;a table first becomes the Table&br;Master.
ルームに設置してある対戦を行う場を&#34;テーブル&#34;と呼びます。1つの: The place set up in a room where matches are played is called a "table". Up to three people can join a single table.&br;A table always shows its current status.&br;Selecting a table displays a "table menu" suited to that table&squo;s status. You join a match from this menu.

召喚獣のカードが手に入るギルドです。: The guild where you obtain eidolon cards.
回転ブロックは、接触した対戦相手のすべてのカードを、回転ブロックに攻撃を仕掛けた: A rotating block is a special block that generates "lightning", which can turn every opposing card it touches to the color of the card that attacked the rotating block. It lets you turn cards in places, or with ability values, that you could not normally attack. The rotating block placement rate is set at 25% of the total number of blocks (rounded down). A two-player match therefore has at most 1 and a three-player match at most 2, and none are placed when the total number of blocks is 3 or fewer.
基礎知識を１通り修得したら、次は実際にプレイしてみましょう！&br;ここでは、C: Once you have grasped the basics, try&br;actually playing! This section explains&br;the information you need in order to&br;start a game, whether against COM or&br;against players, and information that is handy to know.
対戦、カードコレクションのどちらを楽しむにせよ、カードを集めることは、このゲーム: Whether your pleasure is matches or card collecting, gathering cards is an important factor in playing this game. This section explains "card collecting" -- the basis of enjoying a trading card game, and the thing that plays the largest part in matches -- and introduces a few tips not touched on elsewhere.
対戦で勝ったプレイヤーは、対戦終了時に自分のものにしていた相手のカードの中から1:
The player who wins a match may take just one of the opponent&squo;s cards that were theirs at the end of the match.
				With a perfect victory, you take every card the opponent used.
				If any card you can take is of a kind you do not yet own, "New Card" is shown above it.
対戦に勝利したプレイヤーには賞金が支払われます。&br;\r\n\t\t\t\t:
The player who wins a match is paid prize money.&br;
				The amount won depends heavily on the Bet Money, the result of the match,
				and the opponents&squo; average rank.
				For the same Bet Money, beating a player or COM character with a high
				average rank wins considerably more.
				A perfect victory pays&br;
				double in a two-player match and triple in a three-player match.
対戦の戦略を考えるうえで、何よりも重要なのが、&#34;数値が低いカードから配置: The most important points when thinking about match strategy are that "placing your lower-numbered cards first makes them easier to deal with if an opponent takes them", and that "a deck should always be built to cover every direction, so that it is not thrown off by where the normal blocks fall". Simply keeping to these two basics will let you place cards to suit the state of play. And because the game system means "you can only take the cards that are yours when the match ends", if there is a card you want, it is important to play with a plan for making that card your color.
対戦を行ううえで最も重要なのは、&#34;カードの各表記を理解しておくこと&#3: The single most important thing in playing a match is "understanding what each of a card&squo;s markings means". This section covers not only how to read each of those markings, but also the game systems tied to them, so even if you have read the manual and grasped the markings and the rules, it is worth a look.
対戦相手の魔法攻撃(M)に対しては、この魔法防御力が働きます。物理防御力同様、防: Magic defense is what works against an opponent&squo;s magic attack (M). As with physical defense, cards with high defense suit widening your territory solidly, while cards with low defense suit use as a "Trigger" to set a combo off.&br;When a card with high&br;defense also has attack&br;type A, it becomes an&br;all-round card, strong in attack and defense alike.
手札をフィールドに配置した際、カードに複数の矢印がある場合は、\r\n\t\t\:
When you place a card from your hand on the field and it has several arrows,
				it starts a battle with every adjacent opposing card lying in the direction of
				those arrows that has an arrow facing back at yours.
				If some of those cards have no arrow facing yours,
				the battles against the cards with facing arrows are fought first, and if you win them,
				the cards without arrows become yours as well.
手札をフィールドに配置した際、配置したカードの矢印が隣接している相手の\r\n\:
When you place a card from your hand on the field and its arrows end up facing
				the arrows of an adjacent opposing card, a "Battle" occurs.
				The cards you place are always shown in blue, and your opponent&squo;s in red.
手札をフィールドに配置した際、隣接している相手のカードに矢印がない場合\r\n\:
When you place a card from your hand on the field and an adjacent opposing card has no arrow
				(so no pair of arrows ends up facing one another), you take that card
				unconditionally. No battle occurs in this case.

攻撃力は、バトルを仕掛けるときに使用する能力です。攻撃力が高いカードは、バトルを: Attack power is the ability used when starting a battle. A card with high attack power suits starting battles and setting off the lightning from a rotating block. A card with low attack power is good for feeling out your opponent, or for setting off a chance block&squo;s special&br;effect early in the&br;match.
攻略へようこそ！&br;&br;この攻略では、基礎知識のおさらいから、対戦で手強: Welcome to Strategy!&br;&br;Strategy brings you information useful to beginners and veterans alike, from a refresher on the basics through to the key points for beating tough opponents.&br;In the animated explanations, following the Steps in order makes even the points that were hard to grasp in writing perfectly clear! Assorted data essential to strategy is provided as well, so use it as a reference and enjoy Tetra Master all the more deeply.&br;
機能呼びだしアイコンとは、テトラマスターゲーム画面下部に表示される3つのアイコン: The function icons are the three icons shown at the bottom of the Tetra Master game screen.&br;Wherever these three icons appear, using one calls up the function assigned to it, at any time.
機能呼びだしアイコンを使用して呼びだす事のできる3つの機能&br; &#34;P: The three functions that can be called up with the function icons --&br; "PlayOnline Icon"&br; "Chat Icon"&br; "FriendList Icon"&br;-- are explained here.
無防備カードへの攻撃や回転ブロックの雷で裏返した場合は、コンボ扱いにはなりません: Flipping a card by attacking an undefended card, or with the lightning from a rotating block, does not count as a combo.
物理防御力は、対戦相手の物理攻撃(P)に対して働く防御能力です。防御力が高いカー: Physical defense is the defensive ability that works against an opponent&squo;s physical attack (P). Cards with high defense are hard to attack, and the most effective use of them is to place them one at a time -- unshowy but sure -- steadily widening your territory.&br;Cards with low defense are best&br;used the other way round: because&br;they lose battles easily, they&br;make a good "Trigger" for a&br;combo.
特殊タイルもカード強化に利用できるものの一種ですが、チャンスブロックとは違い特殊: Special tiles are another way to strengthen a card, but unlike chance blocks only the card placed on top of the tile is affected. In exchange for that narrow scope they are extremely powerful, raising a placed card&squo;s abilities by two to five times or pushing its performance up to the maximum. Special tiles are placed at random regardless of the total number of blocks -- at most 4 in a two-player match and at most 6 in a three-player match. Which type is placed is decided by chance: Attack Up (sword) 25%, Defense Up (shield) 50%, and All-Direction Arrows (arrows) 25%.

矢印が多いものは、複数のカードに対しての同時バトルやコンボを起こすために、矢印が: Cards with many arrows suit starting simultaneous battles against several cards, or setting off combos; cards with few arrows suit stopping them.

表示された数値を互いに減らし合い、最終的に数値の低いカードが負けとなります。: The two numbers shown reduce one another, and the card left with the lower number loses.
表記されているアルファベットは、攻撃タイプを表しています。カードの全種類中、9割: The letter printed on a card shows its attack type. Nine out of every ten card types are P or M; cards that start out as X or A are extremely rare. By winning battles during a match, however, it is possible to change a P or M card to X, and an X card to A.
裏返ったカードは、一時的にバトルに勝ったプレイヤーのものになります。: A flipped card temporarily belongs to the player who won the battle.
複数のブロックやカードに同時にバトルを仕掛けた場合、バトルを仕掛ける順番を選べま:
When you start battles against several blocks or cards at once, you can choose the order.
				When "SELECT" appears, choose the card you want to attack first.
			&br;&br;Flipping a card by attacking an undefended card, or with the lightning from a rotating block, does not count as a combo.
                            &br;When a combo occurs in a three-player match, the only cards it flips are those of the same color as the card that was attacked.
途中退場について&br;プレイヤーとの対戦途中にゲームオプションの&#34;QU: About leaving mid-match&br;Carrying out "QUIT" from the game options during a match against another player breaks off the match and lets you leave.&br;Choosing QUIT brings up a message asking whether you really want to leave. Choosing "Yes" breaks off the game and leaves it. Note that once you have left, you cannot return to the table where you were playing.
通常ブロックは特殊効果もなく、破壊もできないブロックですが、カードの無防備部分を: Normal blocks have no special effect and cannot be destroyed, but placing a card so that a normal block covers its undefended sides makes it possible to stop that card being taken one-sidedly. Defensive use is the basis of putting normal blocks to work. The maximum number of normal blocks is 6 in a two-player match and 10 in a three-player match. Once that number is decided, each normal block is given a chance (25%) of turning into a chance block, and the ones that change on that roll are placed as chance blocks.
